## dh {#dh}

Work with DoltHub from the command line.

### Usage

```text
dh [command] [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <code>--help</code> | <code>-h</code> | bool | <code>false</code> | help for dh |
